title: Data Science Agent — Study 1 Unmoderated First Run, one participant record
description: Web Product Plan §12 Study 1. One document per participant, filled by the coordinator from the session record. Conventions inherited from RESULTS_SCHEMA.json: nothing is pre-filled by the project, integer 1-5 scores only where the rubric allows, an unanswerable dimension is absent rather than imputed, and a blocked step is a result. STATUS: NOT CONDUCTED — no such record exists yet, and creating one without a real participant violates external-validation/README.md §80.

study.description: Fixed so a Study 1 record can never be mistaken for a reviewer-kit submission.

is_project_author.description: Must be false for the session to count (same independence rule as the reviewer kit, V4.3 §75).

build_observed.description: Captured from the running API immediately before the session (STUDY1_FIRST_RUN.md §3), so a claim about what participants saw names the build that produced it.

time_box_s.description: Frozen at 1200 before the first session; recorded per session so a later change cannot be read as having always applied.

obligations.description: The three things the participant was asked to do, scored separately: a partial success is a result (V4.3 'environment failures are results, not noise' carried over).

completion.description: complete = O1 reached a report page showing at least one finding AND help_events is 0 before that point (STUDY1_FIRST_RUN.md §5.1).

help_events.description: Times the participant asked the coordinator what to do. The protocol says the coordinator does not answer; each request is still counted.

environment_failure.description: True when the trial itself failed (unreachable API, cold start never resolving). Such a session is reported separately and is not counted as a participant failure.

abandonment.description: Required when outcome.completion is incomplete. The frozen triggers are in STUDY1_FIRST_RUN.md §6.

stopped_at.description: Where they stopped, in the participant's own terms. §18's kill criterion turns on this field, not on the bare completion flag.

timings.description: Coordinator wristwatch timings, not product telemetry (R-15 is not built). Quote them as observed, never as instrumented.

mode_label.description: R-02's value claim is that a stranger can tell what did the thinking. Splitting unprompted from asked is the whole point: a debrief question cannot create an observation that free play did not produce.

debrief_exchange.description: The literal question asked and the literal answer, including any second prompt needed.

first_sentence_verbatim.description: The first thing said after the report appeared, transcribed word for word from the recording. Not summarised, not cleaned up.

scores.description: Only the four RUBRIC.md dimensions a first-run session can honestly answer. Absent means genuinely not applicable, never imputed (§79).

blocked_steps.description: A closed list so the fifth session is comparable with the first; 'other' requires notes.

raw_archive_path.description: Where the verbatim raw material lives, under research/external/study1/<pseudonym>/. A reported number should be traceable to this path.

artifact_taken.description: O3 only: which artifact the participant chose to keep, named as the product offers it.

asked_for_something_plainer.description: O3 only: the signal R-06 is designed to serve. Recorded as observed; nothing was offered to them.
